platform: Radio WigWam Grassroots Artist Account Upload and Airplay Route
manual_review_reason: Radio WigWam routes artists through a join/login workflow before track upload. The free Basic Artist allowance, optional paid tier, profile data, rights declarations, metadata, upload controls and any runtime human-verification or session checks require owner-controlled review. Do not create an account, log in, accept terms, upload a track or enter a payment flow automatically.

platform: Lonely Oak Radio MP3 WAV Song EP and Album Upload Route
manual_review_reason: Lonely Oak publishes separate song and album upload workflows requesting MP3/WAV audio at 320 kbps or higher, an email account, a social account, metadata and optional biography material. The rendered upload pages are dynamic and a separate paid-promotion route exists. A human must inspect the live fields, permissions, rights language, upload limits and any challenge before supplying files; the contact form must not be used for music.

platform: Radio TFSC Indie Music MP3 Email Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Radio TFSC publishes a direct music email route and asks for MP3 files with complete Contributing Artist and Title metadata, no duplicate submissions and no expiring transfer links. A human must verify the final metadata, attachment size, clean/explicit status, rights and personalized email copy. The separate general contact form is protected by reCAPTCHA and must not be automated or used as a substitute for the music route.

platform: Reprezent Radio UK Underground Playlist Pre-Submission Routing Inquiry
manual_review_reason: Reprezent publishes current UK-underground playlists and public business contacts but does not publish a dedicated unsolicited-music submission workflow on the reviewed pages. MarcsMusic is not a UK-based act, so a human may send only a concise asset-free inquiry asking whether international independent releases are eligible and which authorized route applies. Do not attach audio, paste private links or treat general, marketing or partnership addresses as automatic submission permission.

platform: WNHU 88.7 University of New Haven Official Station Pre-Submission Routing Inquiry
manual_review_reason: WNHU's official site confirms an active student-run variety station and links official social channels, but it does not publish a dedicated music-submission email, form or delivery specification. A human must first identify the current authorized station contact through the visible official site or linked official channel and send only an asset-free routing question. Do not guess staff addresses, send music by direct message, or supply files or links without explicit instructions.
